settings.eyebrow: The Velvet Attic · Curated vintage in the old mill district
settings.headline:
Clothes with a past,
made for your now.
settings.copy: The Velvet Attic is a small, fiercely curated vintage boutique. Every piece on our rails was chosen by hand, checked seam by seam, and given the repairs it needed to live again. No bins, no bulk — just the good stuff, waiting for the right person.

trust_list.text: Every piece inspected, mended, and ready to wear
New arrivals every Thursday, hand-picked by our buyers
Sizes 0–26, plus a dedicated menswear rail
Free local pickup and easy nationwide shipping

stats.label: Pieces rescued and rehomed since we opened
Years of fashion covered, 1920s to the 1990s
Local makers and menders we work with

settings.title: Six rails, one
settings.intro: We don't chase trends — we chase character. Here's what you'll find when you step through the door.

features.title: Dresses & gowns
features.text: From 1940s tea dresses to 1980s power shoulders, a rail of occasion pieces that turn heads and start conversations.

features.title: Denim & workwear
features.text: Vintage Levi's, chore coats, and honest workwear that's been broken in by real life — not by a machine.

features.title: Outerwear
features.text: Wool coats, leather jackets, and trench coats with the patina only decades can give. Inspected and relined where needed.

features.title: Menswear
features.text: A dedicated rail of shirts, trousers, and jackets — from Ivy League prep to mid-century tailoring.

features.title: Accessories
features.text: Scarves, hats, belts, and bags that finish an outfit. Plus a case of vintage jewelry, each piece tagged with its era.

features.title: Home & oddities
features.text: A small shelf of vintage home goods — ceramics, lamps, and the occasional oddity we couldn't leave behind.

settings.title: What our regulars
settings.intro: The nicest part of the job is watching a piece find its person. Here's what they say after.

reviews.quote: I found a 1960s wool coat that fits like it was made for me. The team had already relined it and replaced the buttons. It's the best thing in my closet and it cost less than a fast-fashion jacket.
reviews.author: Nadia P.

reviews.quote: The Velvet Attic is the only place I shop. Every piece is genuinely good — no digging through bins, no disappointment. They know their stock and they know their customers.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.quote: I brought in my grandmother's 1970s dresses and they gave me a fair price and a lovely note. It felt like they understood what those pieces meant. I've been back to shop ever since.
reviews.author: Elena R.
